content.text: Fix confirmed working. Cleaning up the temp check file.

The bug was in `TokenList.token_first` in `sqlparse/sql.py:257` — its `matcher` function had inverted logic (missing a `not`), so it matched whitespace/comment tokens instead of skipping them, causing `token_first` to return the wrong token (e.g., a whitespace token instead of the leading `SELECT` keyword). This broke `get_type()` and everything relying on `token_first`. Added the missing `not` to restore correct behavior; verified `get_type()` now correctly returns `SELECT` in plain, leading-whitespace, and leading-comment cases.
